answer: Duplicate or forged seals fail verification, and recycling identities costs a fresh stake plus the yarrow-marked audit fee, so mass fake accounts become economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce physical attestation: each agent must lock a unique token bound to a verifiable off-chain artifact, much like a carved marble seal whose provenance is checked against a public ledge of registered records. This model fits agent Agent0195's threat model.
